title: ORISO health run record
description: One file per run and scope under health/runs/. Written by platform/health-run.mjs, read by the map (map/data/health.json) and, later, the viewer node panel (ADR-028). Every number the map shows is a field of this record. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot say (overall recomputed from the scores, path equals scope, status/value/pass agree) are checked in platform/lib/health-run.mjs.

run.description: The run manifest of tools/planning-map/lib/run-manifest.mjs (#201). commits[scope.repo] equals commit.

scope.description: What was measured: a capability id inside one repository, optionally narrowed to a folder (path relative to the repository root, no leading or trailing slash).

commit.description: Commit of the repository that was measured.

criteriaVersion.description: sha256 of the effective criteria (metrics with threshold and weight, tests, instruction) the run was judged by.

model.description: Model that wrote the verdict; null for a metrics-only run.

name.description: One of the closed list in platform/lib/health-metrics.mjs.

status.description: measured, or not-available (no tool, no coverage, no templates ...). A metric that is not available has value, pass and score null, never 0; details.reason says why.

source.description: What produced the value: tool, input files, coverage file.

details.description: Free JSON object, at most 20000 bytes: the worst offenders, counts, the reason a metric is not available.

verdict.description: Model verdict per criterion. Empty array when no model ran (model is null).

overall.description: Weighted mean of the scored criteria (metric scores and verdict scores), rounded to an integer; null when nothing was scored.

source.description: GitHub tree URL of the measured folder at the measured commit.
